valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date, 2027-11-13)

bear.driver: Industrial automation demand slowdown and margin compression below the 20.5% FY2026 segment margin guide, driving a multiple de-rating

base.driver: Mid-single-digit organic sales growth and ~17.5% EPS growth over the $8.425 FY2026 guidance midpoint on backlog conversion and margin expansion

bull.driver: Stronger-than-guided organic growth (>5%) with operating leverage lifting segment margins above 21% and multiple expansion

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $9.90, the $222.46 close implies 22.47x; the 6-analyst sample (targets $241-$271, equal-weight $260.33) implies 26.30x at $9.90 EPS or $10.85 EPS at 24.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $9.90 (4.45 pp at the $222.46 close).
valuation.watch_metric: FY2027 organic sales growth and segment margin vs. the ~20.5% FY2026 exit rate
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release and initial FY2027 guidance (expected late January / early February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following Honeywell's Q3 2026 earnings beat ($2.27 adjusted EPS) and raised FY2026 guidance ($8.40-$8.45) on October 22, 2026, five of the six tracked analysts updated targets between October 23 and November 11, with four nudging targets higher by $1-$5 and RBC trimming by $1. The 6-analyst equal-weight target ($260.33, +17.0% upside) sits 10.2 pp above the independent base case ($237.60, +6.8% upside), reflecting either a 26.3x multiple on $9.90 EPS or ~$10.85 EPS at 24.0x. Note that horizon_months is null because broker-specific 12-month target disclosures were not separately verified.
